Armour Class +1 and +1 to all saving throws.

Sefirah Castle is the sefirah of the Lord of the Mysteries, an ancient castle suspended above the spirit world. Its Beyonders walk the seams of fate, space and error, trading spirituality for power beyond mortal ken.
The Door pathway: Apprentice, Trickmaster, Astrologer, Scribe, Traveler, Secrets Sorcerer, Wanderer, Starship, Knowledge Emperor. Commands space, teleportation and knowledge.
The Error pathway: Marauder, Swindler, Cryptologist, Fire Stealer, Dream Stealer, Parasite, Black Box, Worm of Time, Snake of Fate. Theft, parasitism and temporal dislocation.
The Fool pathway: Seer, Clown, Magician, Faceless, Marionettist, Miraculous Merchant, Scholar of Yore, Miracle Invoker, Attendant of Mysteries. Manipulates the battlefield through acting and fate.
Sefirah Beyonders fuel their abilities with Spirituality. Replenishes on a short rest.
